mission.goal: Build the ultimate current-technology MODISA as a durable, proof-bound sovereign execution fabric without production deployment.
mission.workflow: sealed v2.8 baseline -> current primary-documentation preflight -> immutable mission and durable execution synthesis -> adversarial qualification -> hash-bound v3.0 archive
mission.data: Public-safe source, synthetic fixtures and hashes only; no credentials, private evidence or provider responses.
mission.interface: FastAPI, legal CLI, sovereign-runtime CLI, plan-only Redis qualification CLI, Python package, case-level evaluation CLI, benchmark CLIs and source-only Apps Script adapter
mission.stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, OpenAI Agents SDK, SQLite/WAL durable journal, Redis 8.1 client contract, Pydantic, cryptography, Google Secret Manager Python client contract and Apps Script V8
mission.governance: Formation-gated A0/A1 local work; immutable authority in MissionIR; signed target-bound approvals for effects; live providers, secret access, connector mutation and deployment remain held
mission.failure: Fail closed on invalid or cyclic mission IR, authority mismatch, missing or invalid proof, timeout, budget exhaustion, provider loss, approval mismatch or replay, uncertain effect result, event tampering, dependency deadlock and premature completion.
mission.testing: Static, unit, integration, smoke, behavioural, cross-language, failure-first, backup/restore and archive readback checks
mission.deployment: NOT_APPLICABLE: no exact hosted target or runtime identity was selected; deployment and external mutation remain a separately approved mission
mission.continuity: Deterministic archive builder, hash manifest, source provenance, project memory and AI handoff

assumptions.stack: Python-first recovery retains the qualified architecture; Apps Script is a source-only migration adapter.
assumptions.runtime: Python 3.11+ and Apps Script V8; qualification used Python 3.12.13 and Node 24.19.0 mocks.
assumptions.storage: SQLite and local AES-256-GCM vault; webhook nonce uniqueness is selectable node-local SQLite or shared Redis.
assumptions.authentication: JWT roles/scopes/matter walls plus key-bound MODISA-HMAC-V2, exact numeric Google secret versions, timestamp/body bounds and fail-closed node-local or shared replay prevention.
assumptions.deployment: No target runtime, IAM principal, Apps Script project or hosted endpoint was selected or authorized.

proof.semantic_verification: Every independent dependency-ready directive route is returned in one planning pass while a blocked external-trust sibling remains local and resumable. Silent omission, invented elements, missing proof, missing resume triggers, safeguard-bypass routes, unrelated targets and premature completion claims fail. Stale workflow owners and generations cannot update, heartbeat or complete after expiry/reassignment. Every behavioral case executes its declared node independently. Missing credentials select the offline route when live evidence is not required. Open directives and unproven/stale/contradicted fruit veto completion. Concurrent budget reservation cannot overcommit. Caller-selected Redis LIVE evidence cannot promote provider status without separately injected trusted authorization and live-evidence verifiers. Receipt publication is atomic no-overwrite. Provider storage and sensitive trace payload capture default off. No hosted agent, container, live Redis/provider/failover, Apps Script or cloud deployment is claimed.
